Demonic Pact is an extremely intriguing card to me. I've seen a few articles on different ways that it could be useful, and I've been trying to build a mainly enchantment out of Khans, Fate Reforged, Dragons, and Origins. I don't have it completely formed up, but one of the combinations I'd like to leverage is Demonic Pact, Starfield of Nyx, and an exploit creatures. The idea being we can bounce Demonic Pact in and out of the graveyard using starfield of nyx and our exploit guys. I'm mainly playing standard these days, and I'd like to stay away from Theros Block because I don't want my new cards to rotate out so quickly.

So lets see if we can flesh out something to try out. We must keep 5 enchantments in play so that we can Demonic Pact can be a creature. A playset of Pacifism seems required. Playing Herald of the Pantheon will go a long way to keeping a lot of enchantments active. AuraMancer as well so that we can ressurect any of our enchantments that we need. Maybe a myth realized.

For the exploit creatrues, I lean towards Qarsi Sadist and Rakasha Gravecaller. Card draw is always nice, but hopefully we will just be bouncing most of our graveyard back to our hand etc.

What do you guys think? Throw out some idea/improvements.

I took a crack at putting a list together and this is where I'm at:

4 Herald of the Pantheon

3 Demonic Pact

What am I missing? Which cards will I need an answer for?

Eidolon of Blossoms honestly seems like a must if you're playing an enchantment heavy deck. It gives so much card advantage for something you already want to be doing in the deck, casting more and more enchantments, that I really don't think you should discount it just because it's rotating. It's also laughably cheap right now.

You could look into modifying the BG constellation shell in general too. Commune with the Gods, Doomwake Giant, maybe Courser of Kruphix are all still super solid with Courser being reasonable value if you do end up playing modern. Maindeck Reclamation Sage is also solid as a way to kill off your own pact while having value against opposing Coursers, Perilous Vaults, Jeskai Ascendancy if that's ever a thing again. Along the BG lines there's also Sultai Charm if you splash the blue for it. It gives you a way to kill off your pact, can take out a Rabblemaster or some such, and cycles away when it's not needed.

I hadn't considered Charm, but I love it. Definitely going in as an alternative way of getting rid of Pact. I was worried about the opponent killing off a few of my enchantments when they were creatures. That would deactivate Starfield and possibly cost me a game due to Pact's lose game choice. I definitely see the need for some more card drawing. Eidolon of Blossoms seems to fit for awhile. So I'll pick up a few and see how they work. 4 mana seems a little steep for a 2/2 that is easy to remove. I'm a little wary that I don't have an answer for enchantment hate. I guess my only answer is auramancer and starfield to ressurect things. Not sure if that will work once my playgroup and FNM group start to board in responses. I've never played an enchantment centered deck. Looking forward to see how it works out.

There's no real reason to try and deal with enchantment hate. It's gonna happen so you might as well just go over it. You can just run them out of answers by deploying more threats. A Sultai build with Doomwake Giant, Courser of Kruphix, Eidolon of Blossoms, maybe Pharika and then finally Demonic Pact as a way to go really big would be pretty sick.
